name: Raptor Mastery
summary: At his expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary challenges travelers to prove their prowess in the wilderness. The famed hunter demands ten Stranglethorn Raptors slain to test whether you possess genuine hunting talent.

sections.title: A Test of Skill
sections.body: Following your arrival in the jungle after Welcome to the Jungle, Hemet Nesingwary offers to test your tracking and hunting capabilities. Rather than handing out maps or directions, he insists that finding the Stranglethorn Raptors yourself is half the test, challenging you to venture out into the brush and bring down ten of the fierce beasts.

faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary, the renowned big game hunter stationed at the expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, issues this challenge.

faq.q: What beasts are you asked to track down?
aliases: what do i kill for raptor mastery
faq.answer: You are asked to track down and slay ten Stranglethorn Raptors scattered throughout the jungle wilds.

faq.q: Why does Hemet refuse to tell you where the raptors live?
faq.answer: Hemet believes that tracking and locating your quarry is half the trial of becoming a true big game hunter, so he leaves the search entirely up to you.

faq.q: What step comes before this trial?
faq.answer: This hunting trial follows the initial greeting in the wilderness, Welcome to the Jungle.

angles.text: For those walking the path of the hunter, Hemet Nesingwary's trials in the wild serve as a quintessential proving ground of tracking and marksmanship.
